title: Dex Share follow BG delay
symptom: After installing xDrip+ on a tablet and phone to follow a Dexcom G6, readings are often delayed by 5 or more minutes compared to the Dexcom Follow app or the G6 app.
evidence_quote: I chose the Dex Share Follow option and am finding that very often they readings are delayed to the xDrip apps... On both devices.
